Both formats are useful: JSON for a complete backup and browser-standard HTML for moving bookmarks between other tools. The HTML import and export should preserve each bookmark’s title, tags, and original date added.

Merge-and-skip is the right default, and I don’t need a replace-everything option—it creates too much risk of accidental loss. A flat HTML list with tags is preferable to inventing folders.

Import/export now feels complete. I’m ready to review the full scope summary before we lock it.
